rulings.item: Interim rule until briefs A/B land: a fault or window red on a change touching no start-up code is phase jitter when measure.py at origin/next reproduces the same count at some cold/pre pad
Per-class bounds re-derived once after A/B (each may move by 1 once, totals may not rise), then ratchet

informational: Fault-around on mei 6.8.0-149: 16 pages from the 64 KiB-aligned address or the mapping start if later; file offset irrelevant; write and anonymous faults one page
